title: Jantt Plan Specification v1
description: The JSON Gantt chart specification for Jantt.

$schema.description: URI reference to the Jantt JSON Schema.

meta.description: Chart metadata, global bounding dates, and pacing defaults.

title.description: Human-readable title of the project or schedule.

person.description: Owner, assignee, or subject of the plan.

start.description: The earliest date visible on the chart timeline (YYYY-MM-DD).

end.description: The latest date visible on the chart timeline (YYYY-MM-DD).

defaultGapDays.description: Default spacing (in days) between tasks sharing a category without explicit dependencies.

generatedAt.description: ISO timestamp or date string of when this plan was created.

categories.description: Open map of category keys to presentation styling and human labels.

color.description: Hex or CSS color code for the task bar fill and theme highlights (e.g. '#4FAE93').

soft.description: Optional softer/darker accent color for badges or background tints.

documents.description: Optional list of prerequisite documents or artifacts tracked across tasks.

teams.description: Optional list of functional teams or squads (e.g. 'Engineering', 'Design').

id.description: Unique identifier for the team, referenced by person teamId or task teamId.

color.description: Hex color used for team badges and styling.

people.description: Optional list of team members who can be assigned to tasks.

id.description: Unique identifier for the person, referenced by task assignee.

name.description: Display name of the team member.

teamId.description: Unique ID of the team this person belongs to (references teams[].id).

avatar.description: Avatar URL or fallback initials string.

color.description: Hex color used for visual avatar badge (e.g. '#4FAE93').

username.description: Canonical GitHub username mention handle (e.g. '@username') for verified account teammates.

email.description: Email address of the team member.

tasks.description: List of scheduled tasks/milestones displayed in the Gantt chart.

id.description: Unique identifier for the task, referenced in dependsOn.

category.description: Category key matching one of the keys defined in top-level 'categories'.

start.description: Start date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

end.description: End date (inclusive / exclusive range) in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

dependsOn.description: ID of prerequisite task that must conclude before this task begins.

gapDays.description: Minimum days required between the dependsOn task end and this task start.

locked.description: If true, prevents moving or resizing this task in the interactive UI.

progress.description: Completion ratio between 0.0 and 1.0 (rendered as progress fill inside the bar).

assignee.description: ID of the assigned team member (references people[].id) or assignee name.

teamId.description: ID of the assigned team/squad (references teams[].id).

estimatedCost.description: Estimated budget or cost amount in dollars.

fields.description: Arbitrary domain-specific key-value pairs rendered in the detail panel.
